node.statement: Because the fixed direct-corner witness has L^0>=1 and W.L>=L^0, one has W.L>=1. Hence W.c0_cb*epsilon<=W.c0_cb*W.L*epsilon<=t_2. Every amplification of the incoming map satisfies the extended inclusion defect and two-sided norm inequalities at W.c0_cb*epsilon; enlarging their nonnegative tolerance to t_2 preserves all of those inequalities, so the map is an extended t_2-inclusion. The definition of extended inclusion contains no unit estimate, and none is inferred here.
